## Objective
- Add rebirth progress to Pond Pals so players can reset their run for golden fish while preserving permanent meta-progression.
- Provide a separate rebirth screen with a large, upgradeable skill tree.

## Requirements
- Rebirth resets current-run fish and helpers but preserves golden fish and perks.
- Perks include tap strength, critical chance and damage, otter gathering speed, and other upgrades.
- Show progress toward rebirth and award golden fish.

## Decisions
- Implement in the existing single-page `index.html`.
- Use 30 perks across five themed groups, with prerequisite chains and multiple ranks.
- Set a base rebirth target of 10,000 run fish, scaling each rebirth.

- Integrated perk bonuses into clicks, critical catches, passive income, shop prices, and starting fish.
- Added save/load fields for run fish, rebirth count, golden fish, and perk ranks.
